summary: OMA filed a routine Form 6-K furnished under the 1934 Act reporting September 2026 passenger traffic for its 13 Mexican airports. Total terminal passengers fell 4.8% year over year, with domestic traffic down 5.9% and international traffic up 2.8%; commercial aviation represented 99.4% of traffic and general aviation 0.6%. No transaction, shareholder action, board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, premium, or structural mechanism is disclosed. The filing is an operational statistics release signed by CFO Ruffo Pérez Pliego and carries no deal or event-driven risk-arb angle; watch monthly traffic trends and any shift from VINCI Airports ownership.
